(2) A white graphic box appears in the center of the screen containing large black traditional Chinese characters with bopomofo and pinyin pronunciations. (3) Side profile of the interviewer wearing a beige baseball cap, glasses, and a blue hoodie against a backdrop of a wooden door. (4) Close-up shots of the woman speaking animatedly, gesturing with her hands. The lighting is natural daylight but overcast. (5) A sudden cutaway shows the woman in a purple dress and gold jewelry dancing and singing in a dimly lit indoor room with antique furniture. (6) Return to the outdoor street; the woman continues her explanation, displaying various facial expressions from serious to amused. (7) Large yellow variety-show style text overlays and word-play graphics appear rhythmically over her face and the background. (8) A fast-paced montage follows, featuring the woman laughing hysterically as more colorful graphic text bubbles and puns fill the screen.
